gen.title: Limits and Impact of the Emancipation Proclamation

cards.stem: Which limit describes how the measure affected slavery in loyal areas?
options: leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states
freeing every enslaved person in every state immediately
granting land to all formerly enslaved people
cards.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.
cards.hint: Consider which states were left untouched by the measure.

cards.stem: What new military opportunity was announced in the Proclamation?
options: the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy
the immediate grant of voting rights to all Black men
the end of all military aid from England and France
cards.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
cards.hint: Look for the new branch of service opened to Black men.

cards.stem: What was true about Northern war aims at the start of the conflict?
options: ending slavery was not a goal of the war
preserving the Union and preventing secession
declaring freedom for all enslaved people at once
cards.quote: ending slavery was not a goal of the war.
cards.hint: Recall the initial Northern purpose before the shift in goals.
